system.description: Forces another shapeshifter back into their base form. Requires getting a Blood Trait's worth of the Gangrel's vitae onto the target (a successful Physical Challenge to smear it on by force, or a Mental Challenge to apply it covertly), then spending a second Blood Trait and winning a Social Challenge; on success the target must stay in human/base form for one hour or until the blood is fully removed. Works against Obtenebration, Protean, Serpentis, Thaumaturgy, and Vicissitude shapeshifting (levels six and below) and against Lupine/werecreature natural shapeshifting.
system.duration: One hour or until blood removed
